"""Anonymise harvested mail into committable fixtures.

Structure is preserved exactly — quote markers and their depth, sentinel lines,
where an attribution wraps, header-block shape, blank lines, CRLF. Only identities
and prose are replaced, because structure is what the extractor is tested on and
prose is what carries the confidential content.
"""
import json, re, hashlib, random

S = "/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-zach-projects-monorepo/07f4cc2a-4553-490d-a795-03cef6faed4a/scratchpad"
picked = json.load(open(f"{S}/harvest/picked.json"))

CAST = ["Jean-Luc Picard","William Riker","Beverly Crusher","Geordi La Forge",
        "Deanna Troi","Tasha Yar","Noonien Soong","Bruce Maddox","Leah Brahms",
        "Orfil Quinteros","Reginald Barclay","Miles OBrien","Alyssa Ogawa",
        "Ro Laren","Katherine Pulaski","Selar Vex","Tam Elbrun","Nella Daren"]
DOMAINS = ["starfleet.fed","daystrom.fed","utopia-planitia.fed","vulcan.fed"]
FILLER = ("the telemetry export the berth registry the levy column the sensor "
          "readings the statement run the fellow number the settlement window "
          "the reconciliation the manifest the shipment record the audit trail").split()

people, domains, locals_ = {}, {}, {}
def person(raw):
    key = raw.strip().lower()
    if key not in people:
        people[key] = CAST[len(people) % len(CAST)] + ("" if len(people) < len(CAST) else str(len(people)))
    return people[key]
def domain(raw):
    key = raw.lower()
    if key not in domains: domains[key] = DOMAINS[len(domains) % len(DOMAINS)]
    return domains[key]
def addr(raw):
    key = raw.strip().lower()
    if key not in locals_:
        name = person(key).lower().replace(" ", ".").replace("-", "")
        at = key.rsplit("@", 1)
        locals_[key] = f"{name}@{domain(at[1]) if len(at)>1 else DOMAINS[0]}"
    return locals_[key]

reEmail = re.compile(r'[A-Za-z0-9._%+\-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.\-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}')
reMailto = re.compile(r'<mailto:[^>]*>')
reURL = re.compile(r'https?://[^\s>\]]+')
rePhone = re.compile(r'(?<!\d)(?:\+?\d[\d\s\-()]{7,}\d)(?!\d)')
reMoney = re.compile(r'[$£€]\s?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?')
reLongNum = re.compile(r'\b\d{6,}\b')

# lines whose SHAPE must survive verbatim (minus identities)
reHdrKey = re.compile(r'(?i)^\*?(from|sent|to|subject|cc|bcc|date|reply-to)\*?\s*:')
reAttrLine = re.compile(r'(?i)(?:^(?:on|le|el|il|em|am|op|den)\b|\bwrote:\s*$)')
reRule = re.compile(r'^([-_*]{4,}|-{2,}\s?forwarded message\s?-{2,}|-{3,}\s?original message\s?-{3,}|begin forwarded message\s*:)', re.I)
reSig = re.compile(r'^-- $')
reSubjectLine = re.compile(r'(?i)^(\*?subject\*?\s*:\s*(?:(?:re|fw|fwd|aw|sv|tr)\s*:\s*)*)(\*?)(.*)$')
reDepth = re.compile(r'^([ \t]*(?:>[ \t]*)*)(.*)$')

rePair = re.compile(r'([^<>@\n,;0-9]{2,45}?)\s*<\s*([A-Za-z0-9._%+\-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.\-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,})\s*>')

def _pair(m):
    lead = m.group(1)
    keep = lead[: len(lead) - len(lead.lstrip())]   # preserve leading whitespace
    return f"{keep}{person(m.group(2))} <{addr(m.group(2))}>"

def scrub_identities(s):
    s = reMailto.sub("", s)
    s = rePair.sub(_pair, s)          # pairs first, so name and address agree
    s = reEmail.sub(lambda m: addr(m.group(0)), s)
    s = reURL.sub("https://example.fed/x", s)
    s = rePhone.sub("+61 4 0000 0000", s)
    s = reMoney.sub("$0.00", s)
    s = reLongNum.sub(lambda m: "9"*len(m.group(0)), s)
    return s

def names_in(s):
    # "Firstname Lastname" runs, so display names in sentinel lines get mapped too
    return re.findall(r'\b[A-Z][a-z]{1,15}(?:\s+[A-Z][a-z\'\-]{1,15}){1,2}\b', s)

def scrub_names(s, keep_words):
    for n in names_in(s):
        if n.split()[0].lower() in keep_words: continue
        s = s.replace(n, person(n))
    return s

KEEP = {"on","le","el","il","em","am","op","den","from","sent","to","subject","cc",
        "date","begin","original","forwarded","message","mon","tue","wed","thu",
        "fri","sat","sun","jan","feb","mar","apr","may","jun","jul","aug","sep",
        "sept","oct","nov","dec","monday","tuesday","wednesday","thursday",
        "friday","saturday","sunday","january","february","march","april","june",
        "july","august","september","october","november","december","get","sent"}

def filler_like(text, seed):
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    words = text.split()
    if not words: return text
    out = [rnd.choice(FILLER) for _ in words]
    s = " ".join(out)
    if text.rstrip().endswith((".", ":", "?", "!")): s += text.rstrip()[-1]
    return s

def anonymise_body(body):
    crlf = "\r\n" in body
    lines = body.replace("\r\n", "\n").split("\n")
    out = []
    for i, raw in enumerate(lines):
        m = reDepth.match(raw)
        prefix, text = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        stripped = text.strip()
        if stripped == "":
            out.append(prefix.rstrip() if prefix.strip() else "")
            continue
        structural = bool(reHdrKey.match(stripped) or reAttrLine.search(stripped)
                          or reRule.match(stripped) or reSig.match(text))
        if structural:
            # keep the shape; replace only identities and display names
            t = scrub_identities(text)
            t = scrub_names(t, KEEP)
            # A Subject: line is structural — the key and its Re:/FW: prefix chain
            # are what the parser tests — but the subject TEXT is content and
            # routinely names companies, so it is replaced like any prose.
            ms = reSubjectLine.match(t)
            if ms:
                t = ms.group(1) + filler_like(ms.group(3), f"subj{i}")
            out.append(prefix + t)
        else:
            t = scrub_identities(text)
            t = filler_like(t, f"{i}:{hashlib.sha1(text.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}")
            out.append(prefix + t)
    body = "\n".join(out)
    return body.replace("\n", "\r\n") if crlf else body

fixtures = []
for p in picked:
    m = p["msg"]
    fx = {
        "role": p["role"],
        "from": scrub_names(scrub_identities(m.get("from","")), KEEP),
        "to": scrub_names(scrub_identities(m.get("to","")), KEEP),
        "cc": scrub_names(scrub_identities(m.get("cc","")), KEEP),
        "subject": filler_like(scrub_identities(m.get("subject","")), "subj"+p["id"]),
        "date": m.get("date",""),
        "body": anonymise_body(m["body"]),
        "stats": {k: p[k] for k in ("attr","wrapped","hdr","fwd","begin","orig","max_depth")},
    }
    fixtures.append(fx)
json.dump(fixtures, open(f"{S}/harvest/anon.json","w"), indent=1)
print(f"anonymised {len(fixtures)} fixtures")
print(f"identities mapped: {len(people)} people, {len(locals_)} addresses, {len(domains)} domains")
